description_for_human: Delegate micro-tasks to humans and pay them programmatically.
description_for_model: Use this plugin to create, fund, assign, and validate microtasks performed by human workers. You can create a task with a title and reward, fund it to lock payment in escrow, assign an available human worker, then validate the result to release payment. Use this when a task requires human judgment, creativity, or real-world execution that an AI model cannot reliably complete alone.
